title: Trump Announces Diesel Import Deal with Russia; Zelensky Protests Agreement
detail: US President Trump announced a large diesel import deal with Russia, drawing an immediate public protest from Ukrainian President Zelensky, who denounced the agreement as legitimizing Russian aggression and undermining Western unity against Moscow.

title: EU Condemns Trump-Russia Diesel Deal, Says It 'Funds' Russia's War on Ukraine
detail: The European Union officially condemned the Trump administration's diesel import deal with Russia, stating the arrangement funds Russia's ongoing war against Ukraine and undermines the Western sanctions coalition. EU officials warned the deal contradicts allied efforts to economically pressure Moscow.

title: Trump Demands Zelensky Resign, Says Ukraine Needs New Leader Willing to Make a Deal
detail: US President Trump publicly called for Ukrainian President Zelensky to resign and be replaced by a leader willing to negotiate a peace deal with Russia. Trump blamed Zelensky for elevated US diesel prices and framed the demand as a prerequisite for ending the war. Reports from the New York Times, The Times, and The Telegraph confirm Trump made the demand directly, marking a significant escalation in US pressure on Kyiv's leadership.
